methods.description: Look for an inward vertex and classify the outline.
Check whether every given interior angle is below180° or one is reflex.
Name the vertex whose interior angle opens past a straight angle.
Use known shape angle properties to rule out reflex angles.
Check both diagonals: both stay inside for a convex quadrilateral; one outside establishes non-convex.
Reject a conclusion based on just one interior diagonal; check the other and the reflex vertex.
